_doc: Phase H.8 — per-tool exemption registry for check-tool-no-fetch.mjs. The 9 claims in data/security-claims.json apply most cleanly to calculator-style tools (operator types financial numbers, math runs in browser). Audit/grader-style tools (audits/restaurant, gbp-grader, schema-check, seo-grader, speed-test, mobile-check, compare, tech-stack) take a URL and make one explicit, user-initiated fetch to grade it. Different category, different posture. Claim 1 ('Your numbers never leave the page') applies to financial inputs, not a URL the operator typed in deliberately to get audited. Claim 4 ('No localStorage for inputs') applies to financial values, not audit history (which is a feature, opt-in, locally-only). This file names which tools are exempt from which claims and the documented reason.

audits/restaurant.reason: Audit-style tool: takes a URL the operator typed in, fetches /api/audit-snapshot when the operator clicks Share, persists audit history to localStorage as a feature. No financial inputs. Storage is locally-only and can be cleared by the operator from the tool itself.

gbp-grader.reason: Audit-style tool: fetches /api/gbp-lookup with the GBP listing the operator named. Single explicit user-initiated request. No financial inputs.

schema-check.reason: Audit-style tool: fetches the URL the operator typed in to validate its schema. Single explicit user-initiated request. No financial inputs.

seo-grader.reason: Audit-style tool: fetches the URL the operator typed in to grade its SEO. Single explicit user-initiated request. No financial inputs.

speed-test.reason: Audit-style tool: fetches /api/psi with the URL the operator typed in. Single explicit user-initiated request. No financial inputs.

mobile-check.reason: Audit-style tool: fetches /api/page-crawl with the URL the operator typed in. Single explicit user-initiated request. No financial inputs.

compare.reason: Audit-style tool: fetches multiple URLs side-by-side. localStorage holds compare-history (URLs only, no financial data).

tech-stack.reason: Audit-style tool: fetches the URL the operator typed in to detect tech stack. Single explicit user-initiated request.

search-ideas.reason: Audit-style tool: fetches /api/did-you-mean for keyword expansions on the operator's input.

storefront-health.reason: Composite of 6 audit tools — inherits their fetch posture. Saves storefront-property KV state when the operator opts in via Save.

brand-suite.reason: Saves color palettes to localStorage as a feature when the operator clicks Save. Vendored heic-decoder.js (libheif WASM) contains a fetch() in its WASM loader for the .wasm binary — the fetch is to a same-origin asset, not operator data.

menu-copy.reason: Saves menu-copy drafts to localStorage as a feature when the operator clicks Save. Drafts are menu text (Tier 1 / Tier 2 in the data-tiering model), not financial data.

menu-engineering.reason: Saves menu-engineering matrix to localStorage when the operator clicks Save. Mix data, not raw P&L numbers.

open-hours.reason: Saves hours schema to localStorage when the operator clicks Export. Hours are Tier 1 (Public) data.

photo-brief.reason: Saves photo brief drafts to localStorage when the operator clicks Save.
